name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Pagination: page numbers are cells with a 2px frame whose line thickens on hover; the current page is an ink flat that sweeps in; previous / next carry brush arrows. In manga reading order the pages run right to left.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/pagination". It wraps your own components/ui/pagination, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: Cells for pages; the current one is ink.
meta.usage:
import { Pagination, PaginationContent, PaginationItem, PaginationLink, PaginationNext, PaginationPrevious } from "@/components/ui/manga/pagination"

<Pagination>
  <PaginationContent>
    <PaginationItem><PaginationPrevious href="#" /></PaginationItem>
    <PaginationItem><PaginationLink href="#" isActive>1</PaginationLink></PaginationItem>
    <PaginationItem><PaginationNext href="#" /></PaginationItem>
  </PaginationContent>
</Pagination>

props.name: data-reading
props.description: Set on an ancestor (manga reading order): the pages run right to left and the arrows turn with them.
